description_en: The apartment is located in one of the most sought-after residences in the Porcelan area, known for its quality construction, quietness and quick access to main roads. Apartment information: • Gross area: 105.66 m² • Net area: 88.11 m² • Common area: 17.55 m² • Floor: 8 • Brick phase Organization: • Living room + kitchen area • 2 bedrooms • 1 bathroom • Well-organized spaces and functional layout Other settings: • Favorable position in a modern residence • Personalization interior • Peaceful and highly sought-after family living environment For more information or to visit it up close, contact us!
